title: Premium Billing Accounts — Vision Plans Enrollment Added After the Annual Prepay Renewal Invoice
content:
**Rule.** For a Vision Plans enrollment the account holder applies for on a Cascade Individual Annual Prepay account after the account's renewal invoice is issued — and only for such a plan — the renewal payment collects its premium. The amount below is added to the renewal payment after any deduction; the total is floored at 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

The enrollment concerned is the subscriber's vision enrollment funded by the account that is applied or active (neither terminated nor cancelled), the one with the latest coverage effective date (of two, the one recorded first), priced at its plan's monthly premium for its recorded coverage tier; nothing is added where none is on record. It was applied for after the renewal invoice was issued when its application date is later than the renewal invoice's date.

| The enrollment was applied for after the renewal invoice was issued, and its coverage starts | Added |
|---|---|
| on the renewal start | the renewal invoice's months covered multiplied by its monthly premium, reduced by the prepay discount percentage (4 percent) |
| later inside the renewal year | its months from its start through the renewal year's last month — the renewal invoice's months covered less the whole calendar months from the renewal start to its start — at its monthly premium without the prepay discount, which applies only to a full prepaid year |
| otherwise (including an enrollment applied for on or before the renewal invoice's date, which is billed on that invoice) | nothing |

The renewal invoice is the invoice issued last (of two issued on the same day, the one recorded first); the renewal year is its coverage months, starting with its coverage month (the renewal start) and running for its months covered, and renewal premiums are reduced by the arrangement's prepay discount percentage (4 percent on Cascade Individual Annual Prepay). Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are counted the way an anniversary is counted: a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it.

**Hypothetical cases** (renewal invoice dated 17 August for 12 months from 1 October; vision monthly premium 14.60).
- Applied for 2 September, coverage from 1 October: 12 multiplied by 14.60, less 4 percent: 168.192.
- Applied for 2 September, coverage from 1 December: 2 whole months from 1 October, so 10 months at 14.60: 146.00.
- Applied for 10 August, before the invoice: nothing.
